purpose: Screen estimator-specific recovery sensitivity across a known probabilistic assignment dose while preserving Person/Rater degrees, context exposure, response potential outcomes, and estimand boundaries.

assignment.method: exact fixed-margin DP with rejection of disconnected graphs

data_generating_process.common_random_numbers: Within replicate, all gamma conditions select from the same complete Person-by-Rater-by-Task-by-Criterion potential-response matrix. Assignment generation never reads realized or potential Score.

estimation_layers.role: same-estimand external implementation calibration and within-JMLE gamma sensitivity

estimation_layers.estimand: normal-person marginal likelihood with population SD fixed at 0.8
normal-person marginal likelihood with population SD estimated

within_estimator_metrics: mean truth error by Rater level
screening_endpoints.inference: Report means, SDs, and t intervals as screening precision descriptions only; no confirmatory p-value or superiority decision.

method_comparison_contract.fixed_theta_conditional_scope: Monte Carlo variation covers exact assignment draws and response draws conditional on one frozen 80-Person vector; it does not include repeated Person-population sampling.

precision_contract.scientific_recovery: Use native-precision Python truth errors within each estimator lane.
precision_contract.facets_measure_threshold: Use the registered high-precision Umean=6 primary report for measures and thresholds.
precision_contract.facets_fit: Keep separately parsed ordinary displayed fit fields as rounded evidence only.
precision_contract.prohibition: Never reconstruct unreported raw fit or residual statistics from FACETS' usual two-decimal display.

qualification_gates: All 30 assignment graphs and row materializations pass every frozen invariant.
All datasets retain all four categories within each Criterion and constrained PCM nullity zero.
All 120 attempts complete and all native estimator evidence is inference-ready.
All 30 FACETS/Python JMLE pairs pass the registered same-estimand direct-agreement gate.
All gamma conditions have exactly 10 finite within-estimator endpoint rows.
No FACETS rounded fit value enters recovery or inferential calculations.
claim_limit: This screening can reveal candidate gamma-sensitivity patterns under one fixed Person vector, one four-Rater exact assignment family, and one correctly specified PCM. It cannot estimate a real assignment mechanism, identify MAR/MNAR, prove universal estimator robustness, rank estimators, or support confirmatory claims.
